_about: Sicknesses of the world (Data.NPCS.sickness). contagion: the chance a day that one sick person passes it to each person they live, work or mingle with. days: how long it lasts. harm: health lost a day at full strength (each case is milder or worse, SEVERITY). onset: the chance a day that anyone falls sick of it with no one to catch it from (everyday sicknesses only). outbreak: the chance a year that it breaks out somewhere in the world (plagues only). immune_days: how long the recovered cannot catch it again (null: for life). seasons: how much likelier it is to start and spread in each season. worse_for: how much harder it falls on the hungry and the slum-dwellers. A plague is chronicled when it comes to a kingdom and when it leaves. kind wound: caught only from a monster's blow (Data.Combat.specials), never passed on.
